subject: Post-demo: cost allocation and model mix (chat / embeddings / rerank)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris@shopperai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T16:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: cost allocation and model mix (chat / embeddings / rerank)

Hi Chris / Priya —

Great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps on costing and model mix so we can scope a pilot that matches your budget targets. I pulled together ballpark unit economics and a suggested split based on the usage profile you shared (search + recommendations + a light personalization layer). Attached is a short estimate and the prompt set you referenced.

Summary (high level)
- Monthly tokens: 120M–250M (you said 3–5M active users, 40–50 tokens per interaction as a baseline)
- Target spend: $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (we can tighten this with routing + quantization)
- Suggested model mix (initial pilot): chat 65%, embeddings 25%, rerank 10%

Why this mix?
- Chat (65%): main conversational surface and product search assistant — low-latency, higher-context prompts, higher token-per-request cost
- Embeddings (25%): semantic search / recall index rebuild cadence (daily incremental) — higher QPS but lower per-token context use
- Rerank (10%): small, frequent ranking calls used after retrieval — high-call volume, low token payloads but can add up on unit costs

Estimated unit economics (rounded):
- Chat model (gpt-like): $950 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (dense vector service): $420 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (light transformer): $270 / 1M tokens

Action items I propose
1) You confirm a target monthly spend range (pick a preferred band in the $/1M range above).
2) We run a 30–45 day pilot with the 65/25/10 split and real traffic capture to validate extrapolated cost.
3) Rishi and Monica will prepare a routing suggestion (latency vs cost policy) and an A/B plan for quantization to tighten unit price.

If that looks good, I’ll send a short SOW + estimate and we’ll schedule a kickoff next week.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (PDF, 3 pages), mvp-prompt-set.csv (CSV)

From: Chris Lang <chris@shopperai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shenoy <priya@shopperai.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T19:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost allocation and model mix (chat / embeddings / rerank)

Mina — thanks for the clear summary, and for the attachment. A few clarifications from our side before we lock the band: 

- Monthly volume: leaning toward the conservative 120–150M tokens for first three months (we ramp after that).
- We prefer the target spend be capped at ~$900 / 1M tokens to start — need to stay within FY28 ops budget.
- Model mix: 65/25/10 is sensible. Two notes: our retrieval cadence for product catalogs is every 12 hours, not daily, so embeddings ops will be higher on bandwidth but not necessarily more tokens per call.
- Rerank usage could spike in promotional periods — can we set a fallback routing (cheaper rerank variant) if we see >2x baseline QPS?

If you can update the estimate with the 120–150M base and the $900 / 1M target, we’ll be able to give procurement a clear budget number. Also include an option for a cheaper rerank variant and the expected latency delta.

Thanks —
Chris Lang
Head of Product
ShopperAI
chris@shopperai.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris@shopperai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T10:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost allocation and model mix (chat / embeddings / rerank)

Chris — great, thanks for the clear boundaries. I updated the attached estimate (v2) to reflect:
- Baseline: 120–150M tokens/month
- Target unit price: $900 / 1M tokens (we modeled aggressive routing + 8-bit quantization on chat to hit this)
- Two rerank variants: standard (270 / 1M) and cost-optimized (140 / 1M) with ~60–120ms added latency in our tests

Quick recalculation using the 65/25/10 split at the mid-point (135M tokens):
- Chat (65% = 87.75M tokens) @ $900 / 1M = $79,0xx (rounded)
- Embeddings (25% = 33.75M tokens) @ $420 / 1M = $14,175
- Rerank (10% = 13.5M tokens) — two options:
  - Standard @ $270 / 1M = $3,645
  - Cost-opt @ $140 / 1M = $1,890

Total monthly spend estimate: $97k (standard rerank) or $95k (cost-opt rerank) — both inside the $900 target band when averaged. These numbers assume 8-bit quantization on chat and aggressive caching on embeddings.

Next steps
- Rishi: can you draft the routing policy (latency SLO vs cost floor + fallback to cost-opt rerank if rerank QPS > 2x baseline)?
- Monica: can you prepare a short onboarding checklist and instrumenting prompts so we can measure tokens per call accurately in week 1?
- Chris / Priya: confirm procurement timeline and whether a capped spend SOW (monthly commit) or usage billing is preferable.

I’ll drop a short SOW and updated estimate after I hear back on the routing note.

Best,
Mina

Date: 2028-06-23T09:04:00Z
Subject: Internal: ShopperAI routing + onboarding asks (follow-up)

Rishi / Monica — quick internal note so we can move fast once Shopper signs. Highlights from Chris: 120–150M baseline, $900 / 1M hard target, rerank fallback required for >2x QPS.

Rishi: please draft two routing policy templates (fast-latency prioritized, cost-prioritized with rerank fallback) and include expected impact to unit price in each (approx +5–10% on chat if we bias latency). Add a togglable flag for "cost-opt rerank" that will switch all rerank calls to the cheaper variant when >2x QPS.

Monica: prep onboarding checklist (instrumentation points, tags to capture tokens per call, recommended cache TTLs for embeddings). If we can capture week-1 telemetry we can re-run the model-split within 30 days — include a short QA plan.

I’ll assemble the SOW and include both rerank options plus a 45-day pilot scope.

— Mina
